keyword_screen.method: Bounded all13-page raster and fitz font/coordinate scan, actual column/full-width boundaries retained. Meaningful MyriadPro title/headings, Table36-1/2 named agents/forms/classes and lexical column heads, Figure36-1 through36-20 names and meaningful labels/caption expansions, and lexical heads of MinionPro-Bold clinical clauses are attempted. Regular table cells, captions and body qualifiers are explicitly not claimed bold. Case/whitespace/wrap joins normalized, aliases explicitly mapped and duplicate casefold-term+page merged. Full assertions/numbers excluded after extracting headwords. Not an exhaustive generic-body or clinical coverage claim.
